purpose: Retain the exact already-weighted MoE-tail plus next-layer input RMSNorm chain for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B UD-Q3_K_M decode, while rejecting the slower slot-weighted specialization from runtime dispatch.
source_reference: qwen-kernel@52e240f9c6d91750d0e5e692976cfb67fd9bc603 shaders/add_rms3.comp and src/main.cpp scheduling; arithmetic was adapted to preserve hipEngine's low-precision rounding boundaries.

hardware.cross_card_status: GPU0/W7900 was not used; no W7900 throughput claim is made.

runtime_route.decode_only_batch_policy: The row-bulk prefill path is unchanged. Serial c=1 prompt processing shares the exact decode chain.

fused_boundaries.layers: MoE tails 0..33 and 35..37 feed input norms 1..34 and 36..38

unfused_nonfinal_boundaries.reason: These Q6_K down outliers expose eight BF16 slot rows plus F32 routing weights; their one-block weighted composite regressed production-layer time.

numerical_contract.selected_aggregate: Consume the existing BF16 selected aggregate without changing slot projection or routing association.
numerical_contract.rounding_boundary: Store the combined residual to BF16 first, then reread that rounded value for sum-of-squares and normalized output.
numerical_contract.fallback: The existing combine then RMSNorm chain remains registered and is selected for slot-weighted Q3/Q4/PARO decode boundaries.

selected_decode16_profile.interpretation: The aggregate body removes one residual reread and 37 graph nodes/token. Total-profile comparisons are secondary to the counterbalanced unprofiled wall because rocprof runs showed broader clock variance.

slot_weighted_stop_gate.decision: Do not route the slot-weighted specialization. Keep its exact kernel registration/tests, but use the feature-parallel combine then RMSNorm fallback in production.
slot_weighted_stop_gate.transfer: Default Q4 GGUF and PARO c=1 paths are slot-weighted, so no Q4/PARO speed claim or runtime fusion promotion is made.

benchmark_rollup.workload: 512/128 native-attention + grouped scalar MoE + one-step graph decode
benchmark_rollup.prefill_source: benchmarks/results/2026-07-20-gpu1-hipengine-qwen36-35b-a3b-ud-q3km-grouped-prefill.json; retained because the new route does not touch bulk prefill

cross_format_kernel_gate.cases: GGUF BF16/F32 weight, PARO BF16/BF16 weight, and PARO FP16/FP16 weight; aggregate and slot-weighted ABIs; residual and norm outputs bit-exact to unfused
cross_format_kernel_gate.profile: All six specializations observed at local256, 1 KiB LDS, zero scratch, and 16-56 allocated VGPRs.

correctness.paro_runtime: Unchanged: PARO c=1 remains on the exact slot-weighted combine then RMSNorm path because the production slot-weighted stop gate rejected fusion.

decision.opt_out_removal_trigger: One Q3/Q4 defaults-only milestone and task-16 overlap bisection window.
decision.reason: Exact raw and normalized buffers, exact Q3/Q4 trajectories, intended graph symbol, zero scratch, 37 fewer graph nodes/token, and positive counterbalanced graph-wall results at both required contexts.
decision.scope_limit: Only the already-weighted aggregate runtime ABI is promoted. The slot-weighted kernel variants remain correctness-tested but are not runtime-selected.

excluded_attempts.all_39_fused_wall: The first 512/4K wall samples were launched before the slot-weighted fallback edit and are excluded from the retained-route claim. They motivated the production-symbol split but are not the reported wall numbers.
excluded_attempts.fresh_profile_control: A later opt-out rocprof control had 153.520 ms total kernels versus the retained D0 control's 141.464 ms, indicating run-wide clock variance. The accepted profile comparison therefore uses the retained D0 control and the current retained candidate, while the unprofiled wall is counterbalanced.
